builds.compatibility_note: The installed Spot 2.15.1.dev headers require C++20 (std::set::contains), while the unchanged tlsf-tools tlsf2spot example target requests C++17. The solver/checker and all other targets built with the recorded Meson options. For the full test suite only, tlsf2spot.cpp was compiled manually with -std=c++20 and linked with Meson's link line; no source file or solver/checker build option was changed.

tlsf2spot_cxx20_exception.reason: The installed Spot 2.15.1.dev headers use std::set::contains and therefore require C++20, but the unchanged tlsf2spot Meson example target emits -std=c++17.

route_verification.statement: tlsf2spot is a test-only example target and is not invoked anywhere on the GR(1) lifting route.
